scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:rcheevos && concurrently -k "cross-env BROWSER=none vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:rcheevos && vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:installer: npm run build:rcheevos && vite build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.electron:release: npm run build:rcheevos && vite build && electron-builder --win -p always
scripts.pc:sync: vite build && powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist-pc\resources\app\dist; Copy-Item -Path dist -Destination dist-pc\resources\app\dist -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path electron\* -Destination dist-pc\resources\app\electron -Recurse -Force"
scripts.android:sync: vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd ..
scripts.test: npm run build:rcheevos && node tests/regression/emulator-regression.test.cjs && node tests/regression/retroachievements.test.cjs && node tests/regression/gamepad.test.cjs && node tests/regression/wasm-emulator.test.cjs
